anomalies.description: A large truck is seen crossing into the oncoming lane and colliding with an approaching vehicle, resulting in visible impact and vehicle displacement.
A collision occurs at the intersection: a dark vehicle (likely the dashcam car) impacts a red vehicle crossing from left to right, causing visible deformation and displacement of the red vehicle.
A bright flash and rapidly expanding fireball erupts in the upper right quadrant of the frame coincident with the crash, indicating an explosion likely triggered by the impact (e.g., fuel ignition).

A white sedan collides with a yellow-and-white taxi at an intersection while the traffic light is red for the sedan's direction; the impact occurs around 28.5–29.0s, with vehicles coming to rest by 31.0s.

A bright flash and rapidly expanding fireball appear in the upper right of the frame at 28.0s, consistent with an explosion (likely a vehicle fire or secondary detonation), visible as a sudden intense orange-yellow burst that begins to dissipate by 28.5s.
A red SUV in the left lane abruptly swerves right and collides with a dark-colored SUV ahead in the same lane, causing visible impact and vehicle displacement.
